aim:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished TRANSPARENT 2D ANIME game sprite of an original tactical ranger, in the dark anime combat-illustration art direction of CHAOS ZERO NIGHTMARE: elegant ink outlines with variable weight, bold flat cel-shadow shapes, cool navy-black shadows, warm muted highlights, selectively painted fabric folds, tiny teal accent, graphic readable silhouette. It must visibly read as hand-drawn anime, NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D model/render, NOT chibi.
Asset: waist-up BACK SHOT / aiming sprite viewed from behind over the ranger's right shoulder; entire head and waist silhouette visible inside square canvas. Anime adult man, athletic 7-head body proportions. Identity and kit locked for whole upcoming sprite sheet: cropped black hair partly visible beneath olive high-cut helmet, black headset, charcoal tactical face mask, dark woodland-green combat shirt and trousers, dark olive plate carrier with tan webbing, compact olive backpack with two tan straps, tan gloves, black boots, small teal tab on right shoulder. No cape, no fantasy horns, no logos.
Composition: character in LEFT two-thirds, helmet centered x=30% y=22%, waist at x=32% y=90%. Torso twists slightly right into an aiming stance. RIGHT firing hand near x=62% y=59%, LEFT support hand farther ahead x=78% y=43%, arms naturally bent. The hands grasp an INVISIBLE rifle. Absolutely NO GUN OR WEAPON PIXELS, no rifle, no barrel or stock: leave the gun corridor empty/transparent; a 3D rifle is inserted at runtime between arms and foreground gloves. Distinct separation between hands and open space beyond them. Simplify kit detail into clean anime shapes and cel highlights, not noisy camouflage textures. Clear black/dark ink silhouette, crisp edges.
Reference screenshot 1: pose/framing only. Reference screenshot 2: left-cover tactical stance only. Use CZN-style hand-drawn anime treatment rather than their realistic rendering. One character only, no background, no ground, no text/UI/grid, transparent alpha, 5% outer margin.
aimPose:
EDIT TARGET: first image is our original 2D anime ranger sprite. POSE REFERENCE: second image is the user's exact shooting camera/angle.
Keep the SAME CHARACTER, helmet, headset, short black hair, dark olive woodland fatigues, olive plate carrier, tan straps/backpack/gloves, small teal shoulder tab, and hand-drawn dark ANIME cel-shading (Chaos Zero Nightmare-inspired, strong clean ink contours, large flat shadow shapes). Do NOT use photorealism or 3D characters.
CHANGE ONLY THE SHOOTING POSE AND CAMERA ANGLE to match second reference closely: viewed from almost directly behind and slightly right of the ranger, very tight over-the-shoulder back shot. Helmet/back of head is upper LEFT, body/back fills lower LEFT, right shoulder is foreground and bent right elbow is close to torso. The rifle would be SHOULDERED, pointing FORWARD AWAY FROM THE CAMERA toward screen upper-right, strongly FORESHORTENED, exactly like the second reference. Do not draw both arms spread out side-on. Trigger hand sits close to shoulder at about x=58%,y=54%; support hand sits just ahead at about x=66%,y=45%; the muzzle corridor continues upper-right into space. Shoulders have believable weight and cheek is close to invisible stock. Show complete helmet and waist ending with a natural cropped belt edge; fit silhouette within canvas, with 7% clear margin.
CRITICAL: no rifle or gun pixels in output. Render only character, 2D sleeves and gloves grasping the invisible shouldered rifle. Transparent gap for inserting the future 3D gun. The character's upper arms, forearms and gloves must have clear readable boundaries for a 2D cutout rig. Single finished transparent PNG, no scenery, no ground, no HUD, no text.
ready: Create a finished transparent 2D ANIME waist-up sprite of the EXACT SAME ranger as reference. EXACT SAME original anime tactical ranger as the reference: cropped black hair, olive high-cut helmet and black headset, charcoal lower-face mask, dark woodland-green fatigues, dark olive plate carrier, tan webbing, small rectangular olive pack with two straps, tan gloves, black boots, teal right-shoulder tab. Lock helmet, clothing, colors, straps and body proportions. Chaos Zero Nightmare-inspired hand-drawn dark anime game art: clean ink contours, bold cel shadows, cool navy darks, restrained warm highlights, simplified graphic folds; NOT 3D, NOT photoreal, no noisy texture. New pose: LEFT-CORNER PEEK / LOW READY. Character remains in left half, body leans sideways left and shoulders turn three-quarters, head looks to screen right past a corner. Both arms hold an INVISIBLE rifle in low ready, right firing glove around x=.62 y=.66, left support glove around x=.81 y=.54, elbows tucked, gun corridor clear. Entire helmet and waist visible with margins. This must be an AUTHORED different pose, not a mirror of reference: keep right-shoulder teal tab on anatomical right. NO gun/weapon pixels anywhere, because gun is rendered live separately. Maintain same hand-drawn anime treatment; no background, no cover wall, no writing, no HUD, no logos, one character only.

facings.s:
Asset: PRODUCTION 2D ANIME ANIMATION SOURCE SHEET, transparent PNG. EXACT SAME original anime tactical ranger as the reference: cropped black hair, olive high-cut helmet and black headset, charcoal lower-face mask, dark woodland-green fatigues, dark olive plate carrier, tan webbing, small rectangular olive pack with two straps, tan gloves, black boots, teal right-shoulder tab. Lock helmet, clothing, colors, straps and body proportions. Chaos Zero Nightmare-inspired hand-drawn dark anime game art: clean ink contours, bold cel shadows, cool navy darks, restrained warm highlights, simplified graphic folds; NOT 3D, NOT photoreal, no noisy texture.
Draw EXACTLY 21 separate FULL-BODY poses of this ONE SAME CHARACTER, arranged in an EXACT 7 COLUMN × 3 ROW uniform invisible grid across a square image. Every cell has 5% empty margin. No character crosses cell boundaries. No text, labels, gridlines, shadows or scenery. Use compact 5-head anime game proportions, clear expressive anime eyes when visible, matching kit throughout. Camera slightly elevated 15 degrees, orthographic flat 2D animation art. CRITICAL: ALL 21 cells face the SAME direction: FRONT, faces the viewer; view angle must remain locked across every action, except the body falling down naturally. The rifle is a small plain dark tactical rifle; draw it only when held; no muzzle flash.
Read LEFT TO RIGHT across each row:
ROW 1 (7 cells): idle neutral low-ready, idle breathing low-ready, walk left foot forward, walk passing pose, walk right foot forward, walk passing recovery, AIM shouldered rifle.
ROW 2 (7 cells): FIRE recoil rifle, FIRE recovery rifle, THROW preparation raised right arm grenade, THROW release arm forward, HIT flinch backwards, DOWN lying on side, STACKED close-cover low-ready with knees bent.
ROW 3 (7 cells): HUNKER crouched low, VAULT preparation knees bent, VAULT airborne tucked legs, VAULT landing, CLIMB left hand high right knee up with rifle slung, CLIMB hands level with rifle slung, CLIMB right hand high left knee up with rifle slung.
Consistency is more important than ornament. Exactly 21 complete standalone sprites in the specified 7x3 grid. Transparent alpha, clean silhouette, all same man; no copied official characters, no logos.
